from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import itertools
import json
import subprocess
import sys
from contextlib import nullcontext
from functools import partial
from pathlib import Path
from types import SimpleNamespace
from unittest.mock import patch

sys.path.insert(0, '/private/tmp/sdkbench-product-conformance-20261121/src')
from sdkbench.candidates.adapters import load_adapter, workflow_configuration
from sdkbench.candidates.applications import fixture
from sdkbench.p0 import Bundle
from sdkbench.p0.evaluators import routing
from benchmarks.compiler_sabre_native_cost import _select as previous
from benchmarks.compiler_sabre_trial_reuse import _select as reused
from flagquantum.compiler.topology import sabre

out = Path('/private/tmp/fq-trial-stream-screen-20261122')
out.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
bundle = Bundle(Path('/private/tmp/sdkbench-product-conformance-20261121/docs/implementation'))
config = workflow_configuration('flagquantum-target-artifact')
native_budget = config['options']['max_native_added_operations']
nonces = ['01' * 32, 'e99f9400cba6007b9be3900694e5ea6440bf570cd07046e060ca7856689a47ad', '5a8e1eff6bad7ac6c3dd0f2cab4d63e392b504e26acb76b1be22ab61a4945573']
manifest = {'base_commit': '1dc11c0a5607f32a89032ca779f8c37d1b79e07e', 'sdkbench_commit': '9aa9260920984e2ca05bcb293abb885fccd9c144', 'nonces': nonces, 'compiler_seed': 11, 'native_budget': native_budget, 'classification': 'single_device_fast_path', 'scope': 'Already inspected development controls; not held-out or qualified performance evidence', 'files': [], 'complete': False, 'failures': [], 'source_sha256': {p: hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in ['flagquantum/compiler/topology/sabre.py', 'benchmarks/compiler_sabre_native_cost.py', 'benchmarks/compiler_sabre_trial_reuse.py']}}
(out / 'manifest.json').write_text(json.dumps(manifest, indent=2)+'\n')
for ni, nonce in enumerate(nonces):
    for family in ('qaoa', 'ising', 'hopping', 'qft', 'repetition'):
        rows = []
        for width, topology in itertools.product((6, 8, 12), ('line', 'ring', 'grid', 'sparse')):
            f = fixture(width, family, topology, nonce)
            case = bundle.cases['ROUTE-GRID-08' if width == 8 else f'ROUTE-LINE-{width:02d}']
            row = {'case': [width, family, topology], 'nonce_index': ni, 'variants': {}}
            for name, selector in (('production', None), ('previous', previous), ('reused', reused)):
                try:
                    adapter = load_adapter(SimpleNamespace(configuration={'options': {'sdk': config['sdk'], 'workflow': 'flagquantum-target-artifact', 'compiler_options': config}}))
                    with (nullcontext() if selector is None else patch.object(sabre, '_select_sabre_trials', partial(selector, native_budget=native_budget))):
                        payload = adapter.execute('route', f, 11)
                    metrics = routing(payload, f, None, case, 0)
                    assert payload['final_layout'] == list(range(width))
                    row['variants'][name] = {'metrics': metrics, 'payload': payload, 'audit': dict(adapter.audit)}
                except Exception as error:
                    # Attempt every declared workflow; retain the failure at the process boundary.
                    failure = {'case': row['case'], 'nonce_index': ni, 'variant': name, 'type': type(error).__name__, 'message': str(error)}
                    manifest['failures'].append(failure)
                    row['variants'][name] = {'failure': failure}
            rows.append(row)
            print(json.dumps({'case': row['case'], 'nonce_index': ni, 'metrics': {k: v.get('metrics', v) for k, v in row['variants'].items()}}), flush=True)
        path = out / f'payloads-{ni}-{family}.json'
        raw = (json.dumps(rows, separators=(',', ':'), allow_nan=False)+'\n').encode()
        path.write_bytes(raw)
        manifest['files'].append({'name': path.name, 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(), 'bytes': len(raw), 'rows': len(rows)})
        (out / 'manifest.json').write_text(json.dumps(manifest, indent=2)+'\n')
manifest['complete'] = True
(out / 'manifest.json').write_text(json.dumps(manifest, indent=2)+'\n')
raise SystemExit(bool(manifest['failures']))
